hypothesis: Can a fully trained original native four-block Hybrid with gradient-capable depth and/or raw-action bypass actually use a past selected counterpolicy action's factual consequence to choose better later actions than equally trained conventional linear7 or SSM256 on unseen state/goal probes in a known synthetic two-world family? Correct depth gradient access alone does not guarantee better policy.

source.action_policy: first step forced 1-behavior(s), then deterministic episode-seeded 0/1 exploration, each observed actual outcome used only after selection
source.P80_action_key: state_before4 and actually selected action, L2 normalized 16D

models.checkpoint: fixed update96 (no FITdev checkpoint selection); FITdev scored only diagnostically

evaluation.model_input: 2-event causal prefix factual_probe + hypothetical current action, current effect masked; model predicts current effect WITHOUT committing hypothetical
evaluation.planner: enumerate only two legal actions, score predicted next-state against common target, deterministic action0 ties; then evaluator executes chosen math action and computes regret to two-action oracle
evaluation.primary: mean selected-action squared-goal regret relative to evaluator-only oracle across 2 signs x 9 states x3 goals
secondary: physical four-delta prequential MSE on separate author-toy score worlds

preregistered_decision.native_surrogate_bypass_wins_vs_both_lin: mean action regret <=0.90*min(linear7,ssm256) in >=2/3 seeds AND improves over native hard+bypass
preregistered_decision.strong_controls_competence: one-bit ideal policy exact 0 regret, at least one trained classical has regret <= always-action0 by >=0.1 fraction; if not, outcome non-discriminating
preregistered_decision.retention: identical predictions and choices after fresh model reload; separate episode resets
preregistered_decision.seed_reproducibility: same construction and sampler across arms

qualification.receipts: GitHub G4 job logs and on-repo PR comment, not ChatGPT Library

stop: Reject if owner/branch drift, source contract drift, unknown action, future effect leakage, invalid matrix, nonfinite gradients, missing model parity or CI failure; preserve null outcomes. No new real scientific first-use.
